topic: PAGASA storm signals and tropical cyclone events
key_concepts: PAGASA is the Philippine Atmospheric, Geological and Astronomical Services Administration
PAGASA provides weather forecasts and tropical cyclone warnings
PAGASA provides flood forecasting and warning services
PAGASA provides climatological and farm weather services
PAGASA provides astronomical services and public outreach
Public Storm Warning Signals are numbered 1 to 5
Each storm signal has potential impacts on plants, trees, houses, buildings, water, electr
Class suspensions are based on issued storm signals
Weather conditions before, during, and after a tropical cyclone can be described
Preparedness actions differ before, during, and after a storm
